facts.text: Mandalay Bay Beach is an 11-acre aquatic playground at the resort.
facts.excerpt: Mandalay Bay Beach is an 11-acre aquatic playground that invites you to sun, swim, splash and soak on your terms.

facts.text: The resort's pool area features real sand.
facts.excerpt: An 11-acre pool paradise featuring real sand and wave pool

facts.text: Mandalay Bay Beach has a wave pool.
facts.excerpt: Ride tides in the wave pool.

facts.text: Mandalay Bay Beach has a Lazy River.
facts.excerpt: Flow with the Lazy River.

facts.text: Mandalay Bay Beach has a lagoon to lounge in.
facts.excerpt: Lounge in a lagoon.

facts.text: Cabanas offer a private shaded space with lounge chairs and personal bar service.
facts.excerpt: Unwind and relax with a private shaded space that includes lounge chairs and personal bar service.

facts.text: Moorea Beach Club is a private, upscale pool experience.
facts.excerpt: Elevated toptional oasis providing guests with a private, upscale, and sophisticated pool experience.

facts.text: At Shark Reef Aquarium, guests can view the creatures from inside a shipwreck or dive alongside the sharks.
facts.excerpt: Gaze at the friendly creatures from inside the shipwreck or thrill your senses diving alongside the sharks.

facts.text: Yoga with Sharks is a yoga experience held at Shark Reef Aquarium.
facts.excerpt: Find your flow with a unique yoga experience at Shark Reef Aquarium.

facts.text: Michael Jackson ONE by Cirque du Soleil is a fusion of acrobatics, dance and visuals set to Michael Jackson's music.
facts.excerpt: An electrifying fusion of acrobatics, dance and visuals immersing the audience into the world of Michael Jackson's music.

facts.text: Michelob ULTRA Arena is a sports and entertainment complex that hosts top headliners and is home of the Las Vegas Aces and Desert Dogs.
facts.excerpt: Sports and entertainment complex host to top headliners and home of the Las Vegas Aces and Desert Dogs.

facts.text: The resort has a spa, Spa Mandalay.
facts.excerpt: Spa Mandalay combines the best techniques and products with skilled professionals

facts.text: The One Bedroom Penthouse Sky View Suite has neutral tones with aquatic finishes.
facts.excerpt: This one bedroom Las Vegas suite includes neutral tones with aquatic finishes for a natural and deeply tranquil environment.

facts.text: The Resort King room has been newly remodeled.
facts.excerpt: Our newly remodeled 550 sq. ft. Resort King room

facts.text: Orla is chef Michael Mina's Mediterranean restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Orla is Chef Michael Mina's brand-new Mediterranean restaurant.

facts.text: Libertine Social is from James Beard Award-winning chef Shawn McClain.
facts.excerpt: James Beard Award-winning chef Shawn McClain challenges diners to free their minds from preconceived notions about Las Vegas restaurants

facts.text: StripSteak is a modern American steakhouse.
facts.excerpt: StripSteak Las Vegas is a modern American steakhouse

facts.excerpt: Mandalay Bay offers all of your favorite table games, including blackjack, craps and roulette.

facts.text: The resort has a BetMGM Sportsbook.
facts.excerpt: BetMGM Sportsbook at Mandalay Bay

facts.text: Vinyl Room is a cocktail bar and membership club opening in August.
facts.excerpt: Opening this August, Vinyl Room is a premium cocktail bar and membership club inspired by Japanese high-fidelity listening lounges.

facts.text: The resort describes its dining as award-winning and its entertainment as world-class.
